# ILIKS

## About
Official website for ILIKS, built with Astro, Tailwind CSS, and React. It is specifically designed to provide perfect Lighthouse scores, Semantic HTML, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) out of the box.

## Key Technical Features
- Built on Astro 5.0 and Tailwind CSS v4.
- Generates 100/100 Lighthouse SEO and Accessibility scores.
- Implements comprehensive Schema.org JSON-LD structured data.
- Includes a fully responsive, CSS-only megamenu and zero-JS mobile navigation.
- Native multi-language (i18n) support with automatic `hreflang` tag generation.
